host_rules: Validate each tool name and argument against a fixed schema.
The model proposes an action; a separate host checks permissions and executes it.
Arbitrary model-generated code must not execute as a device action.
Show user confirmation before consequential external actions.
Never bypass Android security or authentication.
Use explicit user file selection instead of unrestricted storage access.
Workspace commands must remain inside the selected project and stop on timeout.
The overlay must not capture touches outside its own window.
All workflows need cancellation, timeouts and a maximum step count.
Capabilities remain unavailable until the host confirms permission is granted.
